mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN profile.qualification_status='APPROVED' AND profile.effective_snapshot_id IS NOT NULL AND (snapshot.id IS NULL OR snapshot.owner_dept_id<>profile.owner_dept_id OR snapshot.company_revision<>profile.training_context_revision OR profile.review_due_at IS NULL OR profile.review_due_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) OR (profile.license_long_term=0 AND (profile.license_valid_to IS NULL OR DATE(DATE_ADD(profile.license_valid_to,INTERVAL 8 HOUR)) <DATE(DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),INTERVAL 8 HOUR))))) THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE profile.qualification_status END FROM vi_driver_profile profile LEFT JOIN vi_qualification_snapshot snapshot ON snapshot.id=profile.effective_snapshot_id AND snapshot.driver_id=profile.id AND snapshot.qualification_revision=profile.qualification_revision WHERE profile.account_id=#{accountId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vi_driver_profile WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND (qualification_status='APPROVED' OR (qualification_status IN ('EXPIRED','SUSPENDED') AND qualification_revision IS NOT NULL))
SELECT sys_user_id, status FROM vi_employee_binding WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND revoked_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vi_station_grant WHERE sys_user_id = #{sysUserId} AND enabled = 1
SELECT station_id FROM vi_station_grant WHERE sys_user_id = #{sysUserId} AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY station_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE user_id = #{sysUserId} AND status = '0' AND del_flag = '0'
